title: Toy Caesar oracle-scored transform check

proposers.name: Voynich@Home contract prototype
proposers.conflicts: The same prototype created the fixture and worker; this is executable contract evidence, not an independent or sequestered benchmark.

exposure_disclosure: The plaintext, ciphertext, transformation family, and correct shift are committed publicly and were visible during implementation.

hypothesis.statement: Exhaustive comparison of all 26 Caesar shifts against the disclosed plaintext oracle will select key 7 and reproduce all 25 fixture codepoints.
hypothesis.falsifier: The frozen worker selects any other key, scores fewer than 25 matching codepoints, or changes output across a restart or independent host.
nearest_alternatives: The fixture was generated by another shift.
The worker's encryption direction or tie-breaking implementation is incorrect.

multiplicity.procedure: The complete 26-key selection pipeline must identify the one registered exact match; no single-key unadjusted claim is made.

controls.expected_behavior: The correct key receives 25 matches and is selected uniquely.
controls.failure_consequence: The contract prototype fails its only executable scientific control.

controls.expected_behavior: Reserved for benchmark v1; no outcome is claimed by this foundation experiment.
controls.failure_consequence: No production generalization claim may be made.

controls.expected_behavior: Reserved for benchmark v1; the final system must abstain from exact-recovery language.
controls.failure_consequence: No specificity or manuscript claim may be made.

controls.expected_behavior: Reserved for benchmark v1; flexible discovery fit must not pass confirmation.
controls.failure_consequence: No complexity-sensitive or interpretation claim may be made.

controls.expected_behavior: Interrupted and uninterrupted executions have identical canonical output bytes.
controls.failure_consequence: The worker is not eligible for distributed execution.

search.algorithm: Exhaustive integer key enumeration from 0 through 25 inclusive.
search.selection_rule: Maximize exact codepoint matches; break a tie by the smallest integer key.

randomness.derivation: No stochastic operation is used; the fixed field exercises the work-unit randomness contract.

validation.equivalence: Exact SHA-256 equality of output artifact bytes.
validation.reference_replay: Replay every toy work unit locally and escalate disagreements to a third replica.

stopping_rule.futility_rule: Stop and report failure if any executable positive or implementation control fails.

success_conditions: All 26 keys are evaluated exactly once by the aggregate search.
Key 7 is the unique winner with 25 matching codepoints.
Replicas and local reference replay produce identical output bytes.
claim_gate.failure_language: This toy may demonstrate only that the foundation contracts and one disclosed oracle-scored fixture execute; it does not demonstrate cryptanalysis and says nothing about Voynich text, historical ciphers, or public volunteer readiness.
